subject: Supplier onboarding: KYC, PO field mapping, and MSA/Order Form next steps
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@mednova.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding / registration questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking our call this morning. We're ready to start Redwood on-boarding in our supplier registry but had a few items we need clarified before we complete registration: 

- Which procurement portal does Redwood prefer for invoice routing (Ariba or Coupa)? Do you support both?
- PO number format: our systems require a fixed 3-letter prefix per buyer (e.g., MED-12345). Is that OK for matching on your side?
- Remit-to address and exact legal entity name to appear on invoices
- Tax ID / W-9 requirement (we can only register once we have the W-9)
- SOC 2 / security attestation fields (we usually ask for the SOC cover sheet to attach)
- Any specific Order Form fields that must appear on the PO for automated acceptance (line-level SKU vs. single line / cost center)

I've attached our supplier intake spreadsheet (mednova_vendor_sheet.xlsx) with the fields we'll upload. Happy to join a short call if that helps.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Procurement Manager, MedNova Health
agomez@mednova.com
+1 617-555-0198

Attachment: mednova_vendor_sheet.xlsx (xlsx, 26KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@mednova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding / registration questions

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We support both Ariba and Coupa; either is fine. Short answers plus required artefacts: 

- Portal: Ariba or Coupa both supported — if you enroll in Ariba we'll provide SLP mapping; for Coupa we provide a punchout/vendor ID.
- PO prefix: MED- prefix is fine. Please include the full buyer PO on the invoice body (we match on the PO string).
- Remit/Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  1227 Market St, Suite 600
  San Francisco, CA 94103
- Tax ID: 94-1234567 (please upload completed W-9)
- SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 cover letter and a redacted report on request (upload as SOC2_Attestation.pdf)
- Order Form fields: best practice is to include a single PO number at the header and line-level SKU only if you require line matching. For automatic processing include: Buyer PO Number, Buyer Cost Center (optional), Invoice Total.

Action items for MedNova: upload W-9 and SOC2 cover sheet into the portal and create vendor record with Remit-to above. Once registered, please share the vendor id and we'll validate sample test PO.

I'm copying Ben (AM) and Marissa (Legal ops) to coordinate MSA/order form redlines and to send a DocuSign link if needed. Attach: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Strategic Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T13:45:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding / registration questions + MSA redline (MedNova)

Forwarding Alicia's note and attaching our proposed MSA redline for MedNova. Key asks from procurement summarized so Legal can confirm acceptability and confirm whether the Order Form will be signed via DocuSign or countersigned PDF: 

- Payment terms: MedNova asked about NET30; their AR system enforces PO prefixes. We can accept NET30 but confirm whether we keep current 1.5% late fee language.
- Indemnity / data handling: MedNova flagged data residency in EU (not applicable here), but make sure indemnity carveouts align with our standard.
- PO field mapping: we need to map Buyer PO Number -> external_po_reference and buyer cost center -> cost_center custom field in Ariba.

Attached: MSA_redline_mednova_v2.docx

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MSA_redline_mednova_v2.docx (docx, 34KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:05:00-05:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Vendor onboarding / registration questions + MSA redline (MedNova)

Ben — reviewing the redlines now. High level guidance: 

- Payment terms: Legal is comfortable with NET30. Remove the 1.5% late fee; we'll keep standard interest at 1% per month.
- Indemnity: we will not accept the broad third-party indemnity as drafted. Propose limited indemnity tied to direct damages and breach of IP obligations.
- Data handling / SOC: provide SOC2 cover letter; do not share the full report unless under an NDA (we will provide a redacted version).

PO mapping / procurement notes (ops):
- Ariba mapping: Buyer PO Number -> external_po_reference (string), Remit Address -> remit_address (multiline), Tax ID -> tax_id. Recommend adding a boolean field "auto_accept_invoice" default false.
- Coupa: use vendor ID field and configure supplier_external_reference to contain MED- prefix sample; we'll accept MED- as prefix.

Next steps: 1) I will prepare a DocuSign envelope for the MSA + Order Form (with variables for PO acceptance). 2) Ops (Kimberly) to confirm the onboarding checklist fields with Alicia. 3) Ben to confirm payment term concession in the commercial note.

Related links: DocuSign envelope https://app.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-1234-DocuSign; HubSpot DN-2026-11-MED-142: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/84321

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: orderform_sample.pdf (pdf, 22KB)

Thanks, Kimberly — and thanks Marissa/Ben. A few quick confirmations from our side: 

- We will enroll Redwood in Ariba (preferred) and will populate the MED- prefix for Buyer PO Number. I will upload our W-9 and SOC2 cover sheet today.
- DocuSign is preferred for signature — please send the envelope and we'll execute.
- Clarify: does Redwood need the full SOC2 report? We will only upload the cover letter to the portal; full report available under NDA.

We'll complete the registration by EOD tomorrow and post the vendor id in this thread so you can validate a test PO. If it's helpful we can set a 20-minute checkpoint call after registration to confirm mappings.

Best regards,
Alicia Gomez
Procurement Manager, MedNova Health
